title: Settlement Agreements Programme Schedule: Payment Count, Spacing and Settlement Window
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Programme Schedule: Payment Structure

Every programme of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements sets the shape of the payment schedule an offer may carry: how many settlement payments, how soon the first must fall due after acceptance, how far apart the payments may be, how large the first and every other payment must be, the latest day of the month a later payment may fall due, and the window within which the final payment must fall due after acceptance.

## Schedule limits by programme

| Limit | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Largest number of settlement payments | 1 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 6 | 3 |
| Smallest number of settlement payments | 1 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 1 |
| First payment falls due within (calendar days after acceptance) | 10 | 30 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 30 |
| Largest interval between consecutive payments (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 31 | 31 |
| Final payment falls due within (calendar days after acceptance) | 10 | 30 | 45 | 75 | 180 | 95 |
| Smallest first payment (percent of the settlement amount) | 100.0 | 100.0 | 50.0 | 33.0 | 16.0 | 33.0 |
| Smallest single settlement payment (USD) | 25.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 |
| Latest day of the month a payment after the first may fall due | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 |

## Reading the schedule

- An interval of 0 belongs to the single-payment programmes: the Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement and the Lump-Sum Settlement have one settlement payment, so there is no interval between payments.
- The smallest single settlement payment applies to every payment except a final payment that clears the settlement.
- A smallest first payment of 100.0 percent means the one payment is the whole settlement amount.
- The Six-Payment Settlement allows from 4 to 6 payments and the Hardship Settlement from 1 to 3; every other programme has a fixed count.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Three-Payment Settlement amount of 900.00 dollars needs a first payment of at least 33.0 percent of 900.00, that is 297.00 dollars; each payment other than a clearing final one must be at least 50.00 dollars; the first payment must fall due within 15 calendar days of acceptance and the final payment within 75.
